rule: Additive. Material already in a kernel stays (18:45). New records enter as evidence where they add evidence or are interpretively or methodologically load-bearing; speculative or visionary records are pointed to as related work and their substance is not extended into the frame on this pass (18:20, 18:45). Earlier versions and duplicate witnesses go to the kernel's history, resolved to their record of standing.

rulings.text: im just checking we actually gathered up all the revelation evidence... is this one represented? https://www.alexanarch.org/s/records/1418/
a more careful records search first... read by title

adopted... for inclusion as evidence, we focus on ones that add evidence... more speculative or mystical - pearl as white stone, space arks, etc - we can point to as related work but their substance should not be represented in the holographic frame

we dont need to remove material already there. speculative is fine - im just not wanting to substantially extend that on this pass. id like to do the same more thorough records search for evidence-bearing or interpretively or methodologically load-bearing components for socrates as orthonym and sappho, too. and the philo component - philo says it outloud is the title. and related work. its a critical join, where you have someone with what seems to be the sappho transform operative in his work also directly naming the logos jesus - its not a small step in the genetic reading.

lets save our work so far... in fact, lets incorporate that work here into each without yet versioning, because we're going to fix up, flesh out, connect to external scholarship, and deposit the philo piece before versioning the frames, and the updated piece will go into the rev first frame. its vital connective ligature, yes?

evidence.note: the Philo piece, once deposited: the home of the join, edged to Revelation First (rung VI) and to the Tenth Muse.
